title: Delhi-NCR under GRAP-3: Hybrid classes allowed as AQI remains 'very poor'

title: Deepinder Goyal walks back on 'Dear concerned Indian doctors' post
content: Deepinder Goyal has issued an apology to Indian doctors following criticism of his new health wearable, Temple. He expressed regret for generalizing about all doctors and clarified his frustrations were directed at specific influencer doctors. Goyal emphasized that Temple is backed by scientific research and aims to provide independent validation soon. The wearable device monitors various health metrics and is designed to operate without a microphone.

title: Wedding ring lost in 1942 found after 83 years, returned to son
content: A Dutch man who lost his wedding ring while threshing grain in 1942 or 1943 has had it returned to his family 83 years later. A metal detector user found it buried 20 centimetres underground in Odiliapeel and personally returned it to the owner's son, Bert Nabuurs, refusing a reward. The ring's engraved wedding date confirmed its identity.

title: US intelligence believes Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had romantic ties with Chinese spy

This connection raises alarms over the potential leaking of sensitive data to Beijing, especially as Nvidia's head has previously advocated for reduced chip export restrictions to China amid rising tensions. Nvidia and Megaspeed have firmly denied any ties to espionage activities.

title: Left India with $8 in 1972, now 'Canada's Warren Buffett' in ₹52,878 crore bank deal

title: After cases of brain damage, US issues red alert to Lowe’s, Costco and Amazon
content: Consumers in the US are alerted to a recall of 3.6 million Little Giant ladders. These ladders can unexpectedly retract, leading to serious injuries like broken bones and brain damage. The faults involve Rapid Locks that may not engage properly before use. Users are advised to stop using the ladders and contact Little Giant for repair kits and instructions. Affected models include Fortress 2.0, Conquest 2.0 and Quantum, among others.

title: Kournikova and Iglesias' $5M Miami land now a 17,528-sq-ft mansion

Previously, they acquired a waterfront plot for $5 million in 2009, which they developed into a stunning mansion. The new midcentury home boosts their total holdings to about 2.5 acres, emphasizing their dedication to creating a serene environment to nurture their three children away from the public eye.

title: ‘Severe’ season: GRAP III in force as air quality plummets; what changes from today
content: GRAP III was activated in New Delhi as the air quality index continues to deteriorate significantly. The average AQI reached 382 at 4pm on Friday, prompting precautionary measures to be implemented. Areas throughout the city are already reporting severe air quality levels, particularly Punjabi Bagh and DTU. In response, certain restrictions on vehicles and construction activities have been enforced.

title: Why new LNG projects may not prevent a global gas crunch this winter
content: Global liquefied natural gas supplies are facing unprecedented challenges due to ongoing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. The International Energy Agency reports that LNG loadings from Qatar and the UAE have decreased significantly. As a result, global LNG output is projected to fall between 10 and 25 billion cubic meters during winter. New projects in North America and other regions may partially mitigate the shortfall.

title: Diwali 2026: 50+ heartfelt wishes, greetings and quotes
content: Diwali, the beloved festival of lights, showcases a rich tapestry of meanings across India. Each region recounts its unique legends tied to deities, echoing values like family, compassion, and forgiveness. Celebrators prioritize meaningful connections through warm greetings and shared experiences, highlighting relationships over material wealth. Today's observance advocates for sustainability, fostering health, harmony, and generosity. Ultimately, Diwali symbolizes the triumph of illumination over darkness in our daily lives.

title: 'What more do you want Shami to prove?': Shastri slams selectors

Shastri said playing in the gym and bowling in an actual match were two different things. According to him, a bowler's ability to bowl 10-12 overs in a match should be a better test of fitness.

title: India's forex reserves dip by $2.69 billion: What's behind the decline?
content: India's foreign exchange reserves decreased by $2.691 billion, primarily due to lower foreign currency assets and gold holdings. Foreign currency assets fell by $2.088 billion, while gold reserves decreased by $559 million during the reporting week. Despite this decline, overall reserves remain higher than the levels recorded in March 2026. Year-on-year comparisons indicate a net increase in foreign exchange reserves of $27.324 billion.

title: Bengaluru family murders: Bodies of accused's wife, mother-in-law found in TN forest

Investigations revealed that S Indushekhar may have removed gold ornaments from the victims before disposing of their bodies. He is suspected of killing multiple family members amid ongoing marital disputes and resentment towards relatives. Authorities are also examining the involvement of Indushekhar's daughter in these crimes.

title: US businessman found dead in hotel room days after arriving in Hyderabad
content: Mitchell Brian Lee, a 41-year-old American, was discovered unconscious in his hotel room in Hyderabad. He had been in the city for business since November 2 with his partner, David Wu. Hotel staff grew concerned when he did not respond to calls starting on November 4. Emergency personnel arrived but pronounced him dead at the scene shortly after the room was accessed.

title: ‘No s***, Sherlock’: Vaughan's brutal dig as Khawaja reopens ball-tampering scandal

Cricket Australia, however, reaffirms its findings regarding player knowledge, keeping the scandal alive in cricket history.

title: Miffed with Parth, NCP seniors eager to revive merger talks with Sharad Pawar

Over his career, he participated in 64 Tests, claiming 229 wickets for India, with standout performances particularly against South Africa and Australia. Manoj Tiwary, his fellow cricketer, honored Shami's impact on the sport, calling him a true warrior. Shami plans to remain active in limited-overs formats.

title: ‘Gave her everything but a weapon’: Man sues OpenAI over murder plot claims
content: investigators obtained search warrants for his wife's chatbot conversations . however, he said investigators initially refused to let him examine the records because the investigation was ongoing . a lawsuit filed by a north Carolina man alleges that openAI’s ChatGPT provided personalised guidance to his wife on how to poison him .

title: Two men charged over shooting at Kapil Sharma's restaurant in Canada
content: the incident took place on October 16, 2025, when shots were fired at the restaurant for the third time since it opened in July that year . the two suspects, pardeep Singh and Saveer Khan, both 22, were arrested on November 1 . police described both incidents as extortion-related .

title: Iran rebuilding missile sites, moving military infra underground to evade strikes
content: satellite images taken in November show signs of construction and digging at two major Iranian military installations . at least 12 other military sites, including missile complexes and airbases, also showed signs of repairs and reconstruction . developments come amid renewed military tensions, with US president confirming fresh limited strikes on an Iranian air defence system .

title: 'Who has time to kill him?' BJP-TMC spar over attack on Abhishek Banerjee's house
content: abhishek banerjee alleged that his residence was attacked by BJP workers around 2 am . he also accused the judiciary of turning a blind eye to the alleged attacks . west Bengal minister dilip Ghosh dismisses the allegations as an attempt to mislead people .

title: Take us to UP in shackles, bulletproof jackets, plead undertrials; court agrees
content: the two undertrial prisoners requested to be handcuffed and shackled during production . the court accepted their plea, expressing apprehension that they could be subjected to a fake encounter by UP police . they requested that the constraints be placed on them .

title: Teacher finds 50 rare orchids thought nearly extinct near Coffs Harbour
content: around 30 botanists had searched unsuccessfully for additional populations before Lambert's discovery near Boambee . it has no leaves, relies on an underground fungus to survive and flowers for only a short time each year . the critically endangered Bonville leafless orchid was thought to be found in just one location on the mid north coast of new south Wales .

title: ‘E20 turned into 420’: Rahul Gandhi alleges petrol samples from K'taka exceed limit
content: alleged petrol companies were supplying fuel with ethanol content exceeding the mandated 20% limit . he cites samples from IOCL and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation . Gandhi accuses both government-owned and private oil companies of exceeding the prescribed limits .

title: BJP attacks Rahul over 'out of context' Amit Shah video amid SIR row
content: parliamentary affairs minister says the clip exposed Rahul's "absolute lack of homework on SIR" the BJP accuses amit Shah of circulating a cropped video and lacking preparation on the issue . he asks who would be held responsible if questions were raised .

title: 'Democratic rights were curtailed constitutionally': Sonia Gandhi reflects on Emergency
content: sonia Gandhi says the damage extended to the country's democratic fabric and institutions . she says people are increasingly recognising the consequences of the government's actions . the BJP chairperson says it will take time to restore our systems til the government leaves office .

title: Sharad Pawar discharged from hospital; doctor shares health update
content: a doctor confirms that the veteran leader is in a stable condition . the 85-year-old had suffered from a bronchitis attack and a chest infection . he has been asked to continue his treatment at home and take precautions .

title: US detains Lawrence Bishnoi aide Harry Boxer, former Jaipur boxing coach
content: notorious gangster is widely known as Harry Boxer . he hails from Narayanpur village in Rajasthan and earned his moniker due to his background as a former sports enthusiast and boxing coach . detained in the united states at the instance of Indian law enforcement .
